name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      phase4_query_bench:
        description: Phase 4 query benchmark mode
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [isolated]

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"

jobs:
  test:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [windows-latest, ubuntu-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      # Third-party actions are pinned to full commit SHAs; the comment is the tag.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # v1
        with:
          toolchain: "1.98.0"
          components: "clippy, rustfmt"
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
        with:
          prefix-key: ci-test-no-debug-v1
          cache-targets: false
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check
      # A second TLS / crypto stack widens the supply chain and makes Linux CI need system
      # headers; postgresql_embedded pulls native-tls unless its default features are off
      # (RESEARCH Pitfall 5). Inspect one complete graph; Cargo failures must fail closed.
      - name: TLS dependency guard regressions
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s ci -p test_tls_deps.py -v
      - name: No OpenSSL or native-tls in the dependency graph
        shell: bash
        run: bash ci/check-tls-deps.sh
      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo check -p ontoforge-action --locked
      # The local PostgreSQL test path (`--features embedded-pg`) is off by default, so nothing
      # else compiles it. Check it here (compile and lint only: no run, no PostgreSQL download)
      # so that it cannot rot unnoticed (plan 03-20).
      - name: Clippy with the embedded-pg feature
        run: cargo clippy -p ontoforge-storage --features embedded-pg --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo test --workspace --locked -- --test-threads=1
      - name: Windows private-console shutdown contracts
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s ci -p test_windows_server.py -v
      - name: L2 104-ID corpus and Display gate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output=$(cargo test -p ontoforge-engine --test l2_gate --locked l2_corpus_ -- --list)
          count=$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | awk '/: test$/ { n++ } END { print n+0 }')
          echo "l2_corpus: $count tests discovered at ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then echo "::error::l2_corpus discovered zero tests"; exit 1; fi
          cargo test -p ontoforge-engine --test l2_gate --locked l2_corpus_ -- --nocapture
      - name: Action SQLite, outbox and write-entry corpus
        run: cargo test -p ontoforge-action --locked -- --nocapture
      - name: SQLite Action fault injection
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tests=$(cargo test -p ontoforge-storage --features test-support --test conformance_sqlite --locked action_atomic_ -- --list)
          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$tests" | grep -c '^action_atomic_.*: test$')" -ge 5
          cargo test -p ontoforge-storage --features test-support --test conformance_sqlite --locked action_atomic_ -- --nocapture

  # Real PostgreSQL + Trino 483 on Linux (ENGINE-05, ADR-0017). The tests are #[ignore]d so
  # that Windows needs no Docker; this job runs them with --ignored.
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      PGHOST: localhost
      PGUSER: postgres
    steps:
      - id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # v1
        with:
          toolchain: "1.98.0"
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
      # The password is masked before it is passed to either container or later steps.
      - name: Start PostgreSQL 17.11 with job-scoped credentials
        run: bash ci/query-services.sh postgres
      - name: Seed PostgreSQL from the aviation fixtures
        run: |
          psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE demo' -c 'CREATE DATABASE editstore'
          psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v fixtures="$PWD/examples/ontologies/aviation/bindings/dev/fixtures" -d demo -f ci/pg/seed.sql
          # The fixed row predicate corpus of the Trino differential test (D-09).
          psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d demo -f ci/pg/rowpred_corpus.sql
          psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d demo -f ci/pg/query_corpus.sql
      # The same conformance cases that run on SQLite in the `test` job, on a real PostgreSQL 17
      # (STORE-01, ROADMAP SC2). Every test creates its own pair of schemas in `editstore`, so
      # the tests do not disturb each other. The database is the one the Trino catalog
      # `editstore` maps (ci/trino/catalog/editstore.properties).
      - name: Edit store conformance (PostgreSQL)
        run: >-
          cargo test -p ontoforge-storage --locked
          --test conformance_pg --test reload_pg --test scope_store
          --test migrate_pg --test history_masking --test import
          -- --ignored
      - name: Read audit conformance (PostgreSQL)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          : "${ONTOFORGE_PG_URL:?PostgreSQL service must set ONTOFORGE_PG_URL}"
          output=$(cargo test -p ontoforge-storage --test conformance_pg --locked audit_ -- --ignored --list)
          count=$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | awk '/audit_.*: test$/ { n++ } END { print n+0 }')
          echo "postgres-audit: $count ignored tests discovered at ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then echo "::error::postgres-audit discovered zero tests"; exit 1; fi
          cargo test -p ontoforge-storage --test conformance_pg --locked audit_ -- --ignored --nocapture
      - name: Action atomicity, races, idempotency and webhook delivery (PostgreSQL)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          : "${ONTOFORGE_PG_URL:?PostgreSQL service must set ONTOFORGE_PG_URL}"
          run_ignored() {
            local name="$1"; shift
            local output count
            output=$(cargo test "$@" -- --ignored --list)
            count=$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | awk '/: test$/ { n++ } END { print n+0 }')
            echo "$name: $count ignored tests discovered"
            if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then echo "::error::$name discovered zero tests"; exit 1; fi
            cargo test "$@" -- --ignored --nocapture
          }
          run_ignored action-atomicity -p ontoforge-storage --features test-support --test conformance_pg --locked action_atomic
          run_ignored action-same-pk -p ontoforge-action --features test-support --test action_pg --locked concurrent_
          run_ignored action-idempotency -p ontoforge-action --features test-support --test idempotency_pg --locked pg_
          run_ignored action-webhook-pg -p ontoforge-action --test outbox_pg --locked postgres_outbox_
      - name: PostgreSQL absent-target source guard
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tests=$(cargo test -p ontoforge-action --features embedded-pg --test source --locked source_guard_absent_target_insert_race -- --exact --list)
          printf '%s\n' "$tests" | grep -Fxq 'source_guard_absent_target_insert_race: test'
          cargo test -p ontoforge-action --features embedded-pg --test source --locked source_guard_absent_target_insert_race -- --exact --nocapture
      # Trino uses a runtime catalog outside the checkout; nightly keeps the checked-in catalog.
      - name: Start Trino 483
        run: bash ci/query-services.sh trino
      - name: Wait for Trino
        run: |
          deadline=$((SECONDS + 180))
          until curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/v1/info | jq -e '.starting == false' >/dev/null 2>&1; do
            if [ "$SECONDS" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
              echo "Trino did not finish starting within 180 s"
              docker logs trino
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          echo "Trino is ready after ${SECONDS} s"
      - name: Start independent L2 ACL Trino 483 and loose control
        run: bash ci/query-services.sh trino-l2
      - name: L2 ACL and corpus behavior (Trino 483)
        shell: bash
        env:
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_L2_URL: http://127.0.0.1:58081
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_L2_LOOSE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:58082
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output=$(cargo test -p ontoforge-engine --test trino_l2_acl_it --locked -- --ignored --list)
          count=$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | awk '/: test$/ { n++ } END { print n+0 }')
          echo "trino_l2_acl_it: $count ignored tests discovered at ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then echo "::error::trino_l2_acl_it discovered zero tests"; exit 1; fi
          cargo test -p ontoforge-engine --test trino_l2_acl_it --locked -- --ignored --nocapture
      - name: Engine integration tests
        env:
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL: http://localhost:8080
        run: cargo test -p ontoforge-engine --test trino_it --locked -- --ignored
      - name: CLI integration tests
        env:
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL: http://localhost:8080
        run: cargo test -p ontoforge --test cli_trino_it --locked -- --ignored
      # D-09: the fixed row predicate corpus, evaluated by Trino and by the Rust evaluator.
      - name: Row predicate corpus (Trino)
        env:
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL: http://localhost:8080
        run: cargo test -p ontoforge-auth --locked --test rowpred_trino_it -- --ignored
      # STORE-02: `reload` makes Trino see the new tables and columns of the edit store (the
      # `editstore` catalog) before the new definition becomes active, which includes
      # `CALL system.flush_metadata_cache()` through the client (RESEARCH A5).
      - name: Reload visibility probe (Trino + PostgreSQL)
        env:
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL: http://localhost:8080
        # A catalog-wide flush from one case would invalidate another case's stale metadata.
        run: cargo test -p ontoforge-storage --locked --test reload_trino_it -- --ignored --test-threads=1
      - name: Query read storage integration (PostgreSQL)
        run: cargo test -p ontoforge-storage --test query_read_pg --locked -- --ignored --test-threads=1
      - name: Query integration (Trino + PostgreSQL)
        env:
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL: http://localhost:8080
          ONTOFORGE_QUERY_PLAN_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/query-plans
        run: cargo test -p ontoforge-query --test trino_query_it --locked -- --ignored --test-threads=1
      - name: Query benchmark smoke (Trino + PostgreSQL)
        env:
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL: http://localhost:8080
          ONTOFORGE_BENCH_MODE: smoke
          ONTOFORGE_BENCH_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/query-bench
        run: cargo test -p ontoforge-query --test query_bench_it --locked -- --ignored --test-threads=1
      - name: Action source integration (Trino + PostgreSQL)
        env:
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL: http://localhost:8080
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          : "${ONTOFORGE_PG_URL:?PostgreSQL service must set ONTOFORGE_PG_URL}"
          : "${ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL:?Trino service must set ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL}"
          output=$(cargo test -p ontoforge-action --test trino_action_it --locked trino_action_ -- --ignored --list)
          count=$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | awk '/: test$/ { n++ } END { print n+0 }')
          echo "trino_action_it: $count ignored tests discovered"
          if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then echo "::error::trino_action_it discovered zero tests"; exit 1; fi
          cargo test -p ontoforge-action --test trino_action_it --locked trino_action_ -- --ignored --nocapture
      # A green run must not mean "nothing ran" (RESEARCH Pitfall 8).
      - name: Ignored tests are actually there
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          targets=(
            "ontoforge-engine trino_it"
            "ontoforge-engine trino_l2_acl_it"
            "ontoforge cli_trino_it"
            "ontoforge-storage conformance_pg"
            "ontoforge-storage reload_pg"
            "ontoforge-storage scope_store"
            "ontoforge-storage migrate_pg"
            "ontoforge-storage history_masking"
            "ontoforge-storage import"
            "ontoforge-storage reload_trino_it"
            "ontoforge-storage query_read_pg"
            "ontoforge-auth rowpred_trino_it"
            "ontoforge-query trino_query_it"
            "ontoforge-query query_bench_it"
            "ontoforge-action outbox_pg"
            "ontoforge-action trino_action_it"
          )
          for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
            set -- $target
            if ! count=$(cargo test -p "$1" --test "$2" --locked -- --ignored --list | awk '/: test$/ { n++ } END { print n+0; exit(n > 0 ? 0 : 1) }'); then
              echo "::error::$2 discovery failed or lists no ignored tests"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "$2: $count ignored tests"
          done
      - id: credential_scan
        name: Check query artifacts for job credentials
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: bash ci/query-services.sh check-artifacts target/query-plans target/query-bench
      - name: Upload distributed query plans
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.credential_scan.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: phase4-query-plans
          path: target/query-plans/*.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Upload query benchmark smoke evidence
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.credential_scan.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: phase4-query-bench-smoke
          path: target/query-bench/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Trino logs
        if: failure()
        run: docker logs trino 2>&1 || true
      - name: L2 ACL Trino logs
        if: failure()
        run: docker logs ontoforge-trino-l2 2>&1 || true
      - name: PostgreSQL logs
        if: failure()
        run: docker logs postgres 2>&1 || true
      - name: Clean up query containers and catalog
        if: ${{ always() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: bash ci/query-services.sh cleanup

  isolated-query-bench:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.phase4_query_bench == 'isolated' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      PGHOST: localhost
      PGUSER: postgres
    steps:
      - id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # v1
        with:
          toolchain: "1.98.0"
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
      - name: Start dedicated PostgreSQL 17.11 with job-scoped credentials
        run: bash ci/query-services.sh postgres
      - name: Seed dedicated PostgreSQL
        run: |
          psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE demo' -c 'CREATE DATABASE editstore'
          psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v fixtures="$PWD/examples/ontologies/aviation/bindings/dev/fixtures" -d demo -f ci/pg/seed.sql
          psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d demo -f ci/pg/query_corpus.sql
      - name: Start dedicated Trino 483
        run: bash ci/query-services.sh trino
      - name: Wait for dedicated Trino
        run: |
          deadline=$((SECONDS + 180))
          until curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/v1/info | jq -e '.starting == false' >/dev/null 2>&1; do
            if [ "$SECONDS" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
              echo "Trino did not finish starting within 180 s"
              docker logs trino
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
      - name: Query benchmark isolated thresholds
        env:
          ONTOFORGE_TRINO_URL: http://localhost:8080
          ONTOFORGE_BENCH_MODE: isolated
          ONTOFORGE_BENCH_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/query-bench
        run: cargo test -p ontoforge-query --test query_bench_it --locked -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
      - id: credential_scan
        name: Check benchmark artifact for job credentials
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: bash ci/query-services.sh check-artifacts target/query-bench
      - name: Upload isolated raw timings and distributed EXPLAIN
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.credential_scan.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: phase4-query-bench-isolated
          path: target/query-bench/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Trino logs
        if: failure()
        run: docker logs trino 2>&1 || true
      - name: PostgreSQL logs
        if: failure()
        run: docker logs postgres 2>&1 || true
      - name: Clean up query containers and catalog
        if: ${{ always() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: bash ci/query-services.sh cleanup

  phase7-real-services:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # v1
        with:
          toolchain: "1.98.0"
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: "24.22.1"
      - name: Real PostgreSQL, Trino, Rust and TypeScript named suites
        run: bash ci/server-services.sh verify
      - id: credential_scan
        name: Check server evidence for job credentials
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: bash ci/server-services.sh check-artifacts
      - name: Upload server evidence
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.credential_scan.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: phase7-real-services
          path: target/phase7-services/evidence/**
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Clean up Phase 7 services
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: bash ci/server-services.sh cleanup

# ADR-0002 命名规范

- status: accepted
- date: 2026-10-15

## Context
设计参考了 bkn-foundry / open-ontology / open-foundry 三个项目。只借鉴设计，不沿用它们的标识符（如 `kn_id`、KN、BKN、ODL、Domain Pack、`_tenant_id` 系统列等），以避免出处与许可混淆（bkn-foundry 含 OpenBKN License 文件）。

## Decision
1. **概念词汇** 以 Foundry Ontology 官方术语为准：ontology、object type、property、link type、action type、object set、function、interface、shared property、value type、branch、edit。
2. **schema 实体标识**：
   - `apiName`：用户定义、ontology 内唯一、可读；object type / link type / action type 用 PascalCase 或 camelCase 按 Foundry 惯例（object type `PascalCase`，property / link 端 / parameter `camelCase`）。
   - `rid`：系统生成的不可变资源 ID，格式 `ontoforge.<kind>.<ulid>`，`<kind>` 取 `ontology`、`object-type`、`link-type`、`action-type`、`edit`、`branch` 等。
3. **wire 格式（REST / MCP / SDK JSON）**：字段 `camelCase`。
4. **Rust 代码**：遵循 Rust API Guidelines（类型 `UpperCamelCase`，函数/字段/模块 `snake_case`，crate 名 `ontoforge-<area>` kebab-case）。
5. **数据库**：表名/列名 `snake_case`；系统表前缀 `of_`（如 `of_object`、`of_link`、`of_edit`）；不使用前导下划线列名。
6. **错误码**：`UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`，wire 上为 `{ errorCode, errorName, parameters }`。

## Consequences
review 时出现参考仓库标识符即视为违规。

# ADR-0003 Ontology 定义格式：YAML / JSON → 单一 IR

- status: accepted（IR 数据源绑定与类型契约由 ADR-0015 扩展，2026-10-16）
- date: 2026-10-15
- 依据：`.planning/research/rust-stack.md` §1

## Decision
- ontology-as-code 以 YAML 为主、JSON 等价，二者只解析到同一份 IR（`ontoforge-schema`）。
- 解析：`serde-saphyr`（带 span，配合 `miette` 输出 line:col 诊断）；不用已 deprecated 的 `serde_yaml`。
- 导出 JSON Schema（`schemars`）供编辑器补全与 LLM 生成。
- IR 是唯一契约，运行时、存储、API、codegen 均只读 IR（避免 AST/运行时双 schema）。

## Rejected
GraphQL SDL 方言（directive 表达行为能力弱、工具链需自建）、KDL（生态小、LLM 不熟）、Rust macro DSL（非 Rust 用户无法编写）。

## Spike 结论（2026-10-15）
`serde-saphyr` 2.0.0 的 `Spanned<T>` 在 `#[serde(tag)]` / `untagged` / `flatten` 内丢失 span，`deny_unknown_fields` 错误无位置，故不能「直接反序列化进 IR 并按路径取 span」。决定：用 `Spanned` 构建节点树（YAML 与 JSON 同一路径）→ `serde_json::Value` → `serde_path_to_error` → 路径回查 span。IR 不含 span，span 存于并行 `SourceMap`。Plan B：`saphyr` 0.2.2 `MarkedYaml`（已验证 key/value span）。`.json` 文件额外用 `serde_json` 做严格语法预检（YAML 解析器会接受尾逗号与注释）。

字段级文档形状见 ADR-0012。

# ADR-0006 表达式语言：CEL

- status: accepted
- date: 2026-10-15

## Decision
action submission criteria、参数校验、派生默认值用 CEL，crate `cel`（原 `cel-interpreter` 已改名）。进程内求值，非图灵完备，可静态检查。

## Rejected
`rhai`（图灵完备脚本，难以静态分析、有安全面）；自研表达式（成本高）。

## Spike 结论（2026-10-15）
`cel` 0.15.0 无声明式变量类型检查。静态检查范围定为：语法、自由变量根必须 ∈ {`params`, `user`, `objects`}、`params.<name>` 必须是已声明参数、`objects.<name>.<prop>` 必须是 objectReference 参数且属性存在于目标 object type、`user.<field>` 必须 ∈ {`id`, `groups`}、顶层结果类型在可推断时必须为 bool、比较两侧在可推断时类型兼容；类型推断为 `ontoforge-expr` 自建的保守推断（未知即 Any，不报错）。`references()` 对 comprehension 变量有误报，改用自写 AST 遍历。解析必须在大栈线程内执行并预限长度与嵌套深度（debug + Windows 主线程括号嵌套 ≥ 10 层栈溢出）。

# ADR-0011 Cargo workspace 布局（精简起步）

- status: accepted
- date: 2026-10-15

## Context

# ADR-0012 ontology-as-code 定义文档形状

- status: accepted
- date: 2026-10-15
- decider: user（Phase 1 plan 01-01 的 checkpoint:decision，回复 `recommended`）
- 依据：`.planning/phases/01-workspace-schema-lint/01-CONTEXT.md` D-02、D-03、D-07、D-08、D-09；`01-RESEARCH.md` 的 Definition Format Proposal 与 Assumption A1
- 相关：ADR-0002（命名）、ADR-0003（定义格式与解析方案）、ADR-0011（workspace 布局）

## Context
ADR-0003 决定了「YAML / JSON 解析到单一 IR」，但没有定死文档的字段级形状。D-02、D-08 与 RESEARCH A1（LinkType 两端字段与端 apiName 的语义）都是对外契约，发布后修改意味着所有用户的定义文件迁移（one-way）。按用户「决策自主」偏好，one-way 决策在落地前经用户确认一次。

## Decision
用户选择选项 `recommended`：整体接受 RESEARCH 推荐形状，包括 LinkType 端 apiName 的语义 "an end's apiName is the accessor on THAT end's objectType"。用户明确在该语义与 Foundry 原文措辞方向（选项 `foundry-link-direction`）之间选择了前者。未采用的选项：`foundry-link-direction`、`grouped-documents`、`tagged-value-source`。

### 文档与 manifest（D-01、D-02）
- 一个 ontology 一个目录，根目录固定文件名 `ontology.yaml` 为 manifest，无 `kind`，字段 `apiName`、`displayName`、`description`、`include`，未知字段报错。
- 其余文档顶层带 `kind: ObjectType | LinkType | ActionType`。YAML 用 `---` 写多文档；JSON 文件可为单个对象或对象数组。
- `Interface` / `ValueType` / `SharedProperty` 预留，loader 报 `ONT-V03`（v1 不支持）。
- 所有 struct 带 `deny_unknown_fields`，字段名 camelCase（D-05）。
- loader 内部把 `{kind: X, ...}` 重写为 externally tagged 的 `{X: {...}}` 再反序列化，以保留 `serde_path_to_error` 路径与节点级 span（Spike S1）；`#[serde(tag = "kind")]` 只用于 JSON Schema 导出。

### ObjectType（D-03）
`apiName`（PascalCase）、`displayName`、`description`、`aliases`、`hidden`、`primaryKey`、`titleKey`、`properties`。`properties` 是以属性 apiName（camelCase）为 key 的 map，每项 `type`、`items`、`required`、`displayName`、`description`。`titleKey` 缺省等于 `primaryKey`；主键属性隐含 `required: true`（已被 ADR-0013 取代：主键必须显式声明 `required: true`）。Walking Skeleton 阶段（plan 01-01）只实现 `apiName`、`displayName`、`description`、`primaryKey`、`properties`（`type`、`required`），其余字段由 plan 01-04 补齐。

### LinkType（RESEARCH A1）
`apiName`（camelCase，link type 之间唯一）、`cardinality: oneToOne | oneToMany | manyToMany`、`from` / `to` 两端 `{ objectType, apiName, displayName, description, foreignKey }`。

端 apiName 语义：**一个端的 apiName 是「该端 `objectType` 上到达另一端的访问器名」**。例如 `from: { objectType: Airport, apiName: departingFlights }` 表示 `Airport` 上的 `departingFlights` 返回 `Flight`。这与 Foundry 文档措辞方向相反（Foundry 中写在某端的名字是对端类型上的访问器），是有意差异，必须在 JSON Schema description 与示例注释中写明。好处：D-04「端 apiName 在所关联 object type 内唯一且不与属性同名」可直接在 `objectType` 命名空间内检查。

`foreignKey` 只出现在 `oneToOne` / `oneToMany` 的 `to` 端，类型必须等于 `from` 端主键类型；`manyToMany` 不得出现。

### ActionType（D-07、D-08、D-09）
- `parameters`：以参数 apiName 为 key 的 map，`type` 为 base type 或 `{ objectReference: <ObjectType> }`，另有 `items`、`required`、`default`、`description`。
- `rules`：有序列表，每项 `kind: createObject | modifyObject | deleteObject | addLink | removeLink`。
- 值来源（D-08）：单键结构化 map `{ param: x }` / `{ static: v }` / `{ currentUser: {} }` / `{ currentTime: {} }`，不用字符串模板，不用 `{ source: ..., name: ... }` 式显式判别写法。
- `submissionCriteria`：列表，每项 `{ condition: <CEL 字符串>, failureMessage: <文本> }`；CEL 上下文变量固定为 `params`、`user`、`objects`。

## Consequences
- plan 01-03 至 01-12 全部按此形状实现；示例、JSON Schema 快照、invalid 样例与诊断快照固化该形状。
- 后续新增字段（`pluralDisplayName`、`editsOnlyViaActions`、`agentDescription`、`formatVersion` 等）属于 D-05 允许的向后兼容扩展，不改变既有字段。
- 若以后要改端 apiName 方向或值来源写法，需要新 ADR（superseding）并提供迁移工具；本 ADR 不可变。

All listed signatures exist as specified. Additions and notes for downstream plans:

The `dispatch`, `parse`, `discover` modules are private; dispatch exposes `Ctx`, `dispatch`, `parse_manifest` to `loader/mod.rs` only.
- `dispatch::map_error` is the single place that maps serde errors to codes; plans 01-04..06 extend it rather than adding parallel mappers. `walk(root, path)` in `sourcemap.rs` returns the node and last key location for any lookup.
- `Definition` has only the `ObjectType` variant; the `match` in `loader::merge` must grow with `LinkType` and `ActionType`.
- `render`: `Format` and `ColorChoice` derive `clap::ValueEnum`; `sanitize` is public.
- `ontoforge::run(Cli) -> u8` also prints the stderr summary line; `pipeline::check` is the only orchestration entry point.
- Root `Cargo.toml` gained `result_large_err = "allow"` under `[workspace.lints.clippy]`.

## Decisions Made

- LinkType end `apiName` semantics and the rest of the document shape: ADR-0012.
- A `kind` that is declared in the format but not yet implemented (`LinkType`, `ActionType`) reports ONT-V03 "not implemented yet" so a file written ahead of plans 01-05 / 01-06 gets a clear message instead of a misleading "unknown kind".
- Unknown enum values outside `kind` (for example `type: strng`) are ONT-V06 with a did-you-mean help; inside a node that has `kind` they are ONT-V03.

1. 重写 `discover.rs`（per D-01）：输入为「候选相对路径列表 + manifest include」，输出排序后的定义文件相对路径与诊断。候选来源有两种：磁盘（`walkdir::WalkDir::new(root).follow_links(false)`，跳过 file_type 为符号链接的条目，进入目录前过滤掉名字以 `.` 开头的目录以及 `target`、`node_modules`）与内存（`load_from_memory` 传入的路径，统一把 `\` 视为 `/`）。两者走同一个过滤函数，保证行为一致。相对路径用 `camino` 处理并统一为 `/` 分隔，不要把路径解析成绝对路径（不调用文件系统的路径规范化 API，Windows 上它会产生扩展长度路径前缀）。

2. include 处理：manifest 的 `include` 为 None 时用默认 `["**/*.yaml", "**/*.yml", "**/*.json"]`。逐个校验 pattern：以 `/` 或 `\` 开头、带盘符（第二个字符为 `:`）、或任一路径段等于 `..` 时报 V14「include pattern escapes the ontology root」，位置用 `SourceMap::locate_manifest(&[Seg::Key("include"), Seg::Index(i)], Part::Value)`；`globset::Glob::new` 失败报 V14 并附 globset 的错误文本；有效 pattern 组成 `GlobSet`（`literal_separator(true)`，让 `*` 不跨目录）。根目录的 `ontology.yaml` 与任意位置的 `ontoforge.toml` 始终排除。过滤后结果为空时报 V14「no definition files matched the include patterns」，位置为 manifest 的 include 值（缺省 include 时为 manifest 的 apiName 值）。

2. YAML 严格化与消息清理（Pitfall 3、13）：确认解析选项为 strict_booleans、DuplicateKeyPolicy::Error、MergeKeyPolicy::Error、reject_unsupported_tags、with_snippet false，并显式设置 budget 的 `max_depth = 32`（其余预算保持默认：max_nodes 250000、max_documents 1024 等）。serde-saphyr 错误转 V01 时用 `Error::location()` 取 line/column 与字节偏移（无位置则为无位置诊断），消息去掉尾部 ` at line L, column C`，重复 key 的消息改写为「duplicate mapping key `<k>`」去掉库给出的选项提示；预算超限改写为「document nests deeper than 32 levels」或保留库文案中的预算名。

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| 文件系统 → discover | manifest 的 include pattern 与目录内容由不可信作者控制 |
| 文件内容 → parser | YAML / JSON 文本大小、嵌套深度、tag、alias 不受控 |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-01-07 | Information Disclosure | discover.rs include glob 路径逃逸 | medium | mitigate | 拒绝绝对路径、盘符、`..` 段的 pattern（V14）；只在 root 下遍历并对相对路径做 glob 匹配 |
| T-01-08 | Information Disclosure | discover.rs 符号链接 | medium | mitigate | `follow_links(false)` 且跳过符号链接条目；测试覆盖 |
| T-01-09 | Denial of Service | parse.rs 深层嵌套导致栈溢出 | medium | mitigate | `max_depth = 32` + 库内 32 MiB 作用域线程；1 MiB 栈回归测试 |
| T-01-10 | Denial of Service | loader/mod.rs 超大文件、alias bomb、文档风暴 | medium | mitigate | `MAX_FILE_BYTES` 4 MiB；serde-saphyr Budget 默认 max_nodes / max_documents / alias 限制保持开启 |
| T-01-11 | Tampering | parse.rs JSON 宽松解析 | low | mitigate | `.json` 先经 serde_json 严格预检，尾逗号与注释报 V01 |
</threat_model>

# Phase 1 Plan 03: Loader discovery, path safety and parser hardening Summary

**The manifest `include` globs now drive recursive, symlink-free, size-limited discovery shared by disk and memory sources, and every load runs on a 32 MiB scoped thread, so 200-level nested input is a V01 diagnostic on a 1 MiB caller stack instead of an abort.**

## Accomplishments

- `discover.rs` rewritten: `walk` (walkdir, `follow_links(false)`, prunes `.`-prefixed dirs, `target`, `node_modules`) lists candidates; `select` applies the manifest `include` (default `**/*.yaml`, `**/*.yml`, `**/*.json`, `literal_separator(true)`), always excludes the root `ontology.yaml` and any `ontoforge.toml`, and sorts the result. `load_from_memory` normalizes `\` to `/` and goes through the same `select`.
- V14 cases: pattern starting with `/` or `\`, drive letter, or a `..` segment (located at the pattern in the manifest, for example `ontology.yaml:3:11` in the fixture); invalid glob (globset error kind); nothing matched; file over `MAX_FILE_BYTES` (4 MiB, checked from metadata before reading, and from byte length for memory input). Non-UTF-8 stays V01.
- `parse.rs`: JSON precheck now reports character-based columns (serde_json counts bytes) and clamps the byte offset to a char boundary; ` at line L column C` is stripped; duplicate-key message becomes ``duplicate mapping key `apiName` ``; depth-budget breach becomes `document nests deeper than 32 levels`.
- `loader/mod.rs`: `isolated()` runs the whole load in `thread::scope` + `Builder::stack_size(32 << 20).spawn_scoped`; a panic or spawn failure returns a V01 "internal error while loading" diagnostic.
- Fixtures and snapshots for V01 (duplicate key, JSON trailing comma), V02, V03, V14. `RUST_MIN_STACK` is not used.

# Phase 1 Plan 04: Object type fields, base types and structural validation Summary

**Object types now carry the full SCHEMA-02 field set and all 13 base types, `validate` rejects broken primary keys, title keys and `items` with located diagnostics (V10, V05, V06), and the 5-type aviation example loads to the same IR from YAML and from JSON.**

## Accomplishments

- `ir/object.rs`: `aliases`, `hidden`, `title_key` and `effective_title_key()`; `PropertyDef` gained `display_name`, `description`, `items`. Every field has a doc comment that becomes the JSON Schema description. `deny_unknown_fields` unchanged.
- `ir/basetype.rs`: `BaseType::as_str`, `PkSuitability { Valid, Discouraged, Invalid }`, `pk_suitability` (string/integer/short valid; date/timestamp/boolean/byte/long discouraged; float/double/decimal/geopoint/array invalid), `is_title_suitable` (array judged by its element type).
- `validate/objects.rs` rewritten around three checks per object type. Locations: missing primary key at `/primaryKey` value; non-required primary key at the property key (`objects.yaml:5:3`); Invalid type at the `/primaryKey` value; titleKey at its value; missing `items` at the property `type` value (`7:17`); stray `items` at the `items` key (`6:25`). did-you-mean for primaryKey and titleKey.
- Aviation: `Airport`, `Aircraft`, `Flight`, `Pilot`, `MaintenanceRecord` in `aviation/objects.yaml`; `aviation-json/` has the same manifest and an equivalent `objects.json` array. `load_examples.rs` loads whole directories, so 01-05 and 01-06 can add files without editing it.
- Six invalid fixtures with reviewed snapshots (key lines: v05 `1:7 missing required field primaryKey`; v06 `5:17 unknown value strng`, help `did you mean string?`; v07 `2:10`, help ``write it as `Flight` ``; v08 `b.yaml:2:10 ... first defined at a.yaml:2:10`; v10 `5:3 primary key property code must be required`; v10 `3:13 ... has type double`).

# Phase 1 Plan 05: Link types, cardinality checks and the aviation links Summary

**Link types (1:1, 1:N with a foreign key, M:N with a system join) are now a first-class definition kind with located V09/V11/V08 diagnostics, and the aviation example carries five of them in both YAML and JSON with equal IR.**

## Accomplishments

- `ir/link.rs`: `Cardinality { OneToOne, OneToMany, ManyToMany }`, `LinkEnd`, `LinkType`; every field has a doc comment that states the accessor semantics (an end's `apiName` lives on that end's own `objectType`, the reverse of Foundry's wording) and where `foreignKey` may appear.
- `ir/mod.rs` and `loader`: `Definition::LinkType`, `Ontology.link_types`, `LinkType` added to `IMPLEMENTED_KINDS`. `merge` now collects into a `Defs` struct and treats duplicate ObjectType and LinkType uniformly (V08, message `duplicate LinkType \`x\`; first defined at a.yaml:2:10`).
- `validate/links.rs`, run after `objects::check`:
  - V09 at the `objectType` value (`links.yaml:5:19`, help `did you mean \`Flight\`?`) and at the `foreignKey` value when it is not a property of the `to` type.
  - V11 for manyToMany with a key (at the key value), a missing key (at the `cardinality` value), a key on the `from` end, and a key type that differs from the `from` primary key type (at the key value; message `foreignKey \`departureAirportCode\` has type \`integer\`, but the primary key \`Airport.code\` has type \`string\``).
  - V08 at the later end's `apiName` value for an accessor equal to a property or to an earlier link's accessor on the same object type; links are visited in apiName order.
- Four invalid fixtures with reviewed snapshots (v09 `defs.yaml:19:19`; v11 many-to-many `17:64`; v11 key type `19:66`; v08 `19:36`).
- Aviation: `flightDepartureAirport`, `flightArrivalAirport`, `aircraftFlights` (oneToMany), `aircraftCurrentMaintenance` (oneToOne), `flightCrew` (manyToMany) in `links.yaml` (5 documents) and `links.json` (5-element array).

# Phase 1 Plan 07: CEL base (precheck, isolated compile, scope-aware walk) Summary

**`ontoforge-expr` now compiles submission-criteria conditions without evaluating them, behind a lexer-faithful length and nesting precheck and a library-owned 32 MiB thread, and lists member paths with comprehension variables correctly scoped out.**

## Performance

- **Duration:** about 15 min
- **Completed:** 2026-10-15T23:02+08:00
- **Tasks:** 2 (both TDD: 2 test commits, 2 feat commits)
- **Files modified:** 5 (4 created, 1 modified), all in `crates/ontoforge-expr`

## Accomplishments

- `precheck` rejects over-long input (`TooLong`) and over-deep bracket nesting (`TooDeep`, limit 32) before any compiler call. Its scanner follows `CEL.g4` for single, double, triple-quoted and raw (`r`, `br`) strings, `//` comments and numeric tokens.
- `analyze` compiles and runs the caller closure on one `std::thread::scope` 32 MiB thread. The 1 MiB-stack regression test passes: 31 levels compile, 33 return `TooDeep`, thread joins cleanly.
- `member_paths` walks the cel AST with its own scope stack. `params.items.all(i, i.qty > 0)` yields only `params.items`; `has(params.note)` yields `params.note`; positions are 1-based line and char column.

## Deviations from Plan

### Auto-fixed Issues

**1. [Rule 2 - Missing critical functionality] Precheck lexes comments, numbers and escapes, not just strings**
- **Found during:** Task 1 (reading `CEL.g4`)
- **Issue:** The plan described skipping string literals only. Without `//` comment handling, `// '''` followed by 33 nested parens and a second `// '''` is read as one string by the scanner while the real lexer sees real brackets (T-01-22 bypass). Likewise `1r'\'` is a raw string for the real lexer (number, then `r'...'`) and an escaped quote for an identifier-glued scanner. After an invalid escape the ANTLR lexer recovers outside the string, so the scanner would again hide brackets the compiler counts.
- **Fix:** Scanner tokenizes whole identifiers (raw only for `r` / `br`, any case, at a token boundary), skips numeric tokens including `0x` hex, skips `//` comments, and returns `Syntax` for unterminated strings and invalid escape sequences (grammar `ESC_SEQ` set).
- **Files modified:** `crates/ontoforge-expr/src/limits.rs`
- **Verification:** `comments_do_not_open_strings`, `raw_prefix_requires_a_token_boundary`, `invalid_escape_is_rejected_without_compiling`
- **Commit:** `5ff3765`

**2. [Rule 1 - Bug] Byte vs char offsets in positions**
- **Found during:** Task 2 GREEN, first run of `positions_are_line_and_char_column` (got column 9, expected 8)
- **Issue:** `offset_to_line_col` first assumed char offsets; cel 0.15 reports UTF-8 byte offsets.
- **Fix:** convert via `char_indices`; unit test renamed and adjusted.
- **Files modified:** `crates/ontoforge-expr/src/walk.rs`, `crates/ontoforge-expr/tests/analyze.rs`
- **Commit:** `2c35083`

**Total deviations:** 2 auto-fixed (1 Rule 2, 1 Rule 1). **Impact:** none on scope; both tighten what the plan asked for. # Phase 1 Plan 08: Lint framework, ontoforge.toml, E08/E09 and the lint command Summary

**`ontoforge lint` validates first, then runs a registry of configurable rules (E08 action rule combinations, E09 base type use) with levels from `ontoforge.toml` or `--config`, where every configuration mistake is a positioned ONT-V15 and ONT-V errors cannot be turned off.**

## Performance

- **Duration:** about 9 min (first RED commit 15:22Z, last commit 15:30Z by commit timestamps; the start time was not captured)
- **Tasks:** 3 (all TDD, each with a RED `test(01-08)` commit before its GREEN `feat(01-08)` commit)
- **Files:** 18 in the diff against the base commit (before this SUMMARY)

## Accomplishments

- `lint/mod.rs`: `Level`, `Finding`, `LintCx` (with `option_usize`, `option_f64`, `option_str_list`), `LintRule`, `KNOWN_RULE_IDS` (13), `registry()` (E08, E09, then `naming::rules()` and `structure::rules()`), `run()`. A rule only emits `(DefKey, path, Part)`; `run` turns it into a `Diagnostic` through `SourceMap::locate`, applies the level, and sorts. Test helper `lint_rule_on` loads in-memory files, asserts they validate, and runs one registered rule (panics if it is not registered).
- `lint/config.rs`: `ontoforge.toml` is deserialized into a generic `Raw` tree in which every key and value is a `toml::Spanned`, so each V15 points at the offending key (unknown rule, ONT-V id, unknown section, undeclared option) or value (bad level, bad option value). TOML syntax errors are V15 at `toml::de::Error::span()`. `load_config` reads `--config` (missing is V15) or `<root>/ontoforge.toml` (missing means defaults), enforces the 4 MiB limit, and registers the text in the `SourceMap` so the diagnostic renders with a snippet.
- `lint/words.rs`: `split_camel` (`ReleaseDate`, `code01`, `HTTPServer`, `FlightV2`, `isCurrent`).
- `lint/e08.rs`: addLink/removeLink on a non-manyToMany link (help names the `to` type and its foreign key), modify or delete after delete, duplicate createObject by primary key source. N/A items are written into the module doc comment.
- `lint/e09.rs`: discouraged primary key types as warning, nested array `items` as error, title key check kept via `is_title_suitable` (never fires in v1).
- `ontoforge lint`: `Command::Lint(LintArgs)`, `lint_cmd::lint` (`pipeline::check`, then config, then rules; either kind of error skips the rules), shared `report()` in `lib.rs` for both commands, human stderr summary in three forms (validation failed, configuration invalid, counts by severity).

## Interface changes

- New public API in `ontoforge_schema::lint` as listed in the frontmatter. `parse_config` takes `&[&dyn LintRule]` (the plan wrote `&[&'static dyn LintRule]`); every caller that passes a `'static` slice still compiles.
- `LintConfig::level(id)` and `LintConfig::options(id)` are the read accessors; the fields stay private.
- New CLI surface: `ontoforge lint <DIR> [--config <PATH>] [--format human|json] [--color auto|always|never] [--deny-warnings]`. `ontoforge::lib` now has a shared `report()`; `validate` output and exit codes are unchanged.
- `pipeline.rs` and `Cargo.toml` / `Cargo.lock` were not touched (01-12 owns `pipeline.rs`).

See `key-decisions` in the frontmatter. No implementation choice contradicted an ADR: ONT-V15 is the code catalog entry planned in 01-01, and ONT-V structural errors never pass through level resolution (D-06).

- **Commit:** 3ba4d6d

- `parse_config` signature generalized from `&'static dyn LintRule` to `&dyn LintRule` so unit tests can pass local probe rules.

# Phase 1 Plan 10: Naming lint rules ONT-W01 to ONT-W05 Summary

**Five naming warnings (generic or plural type names, ambiguous generic properties, encoded names, mixed date styles, pipeline bookkeeping fields) run through `ontoforge lint` via `naming::rules()`, each with a trigger and a clean insta snapshot, and the aviation example stays at zero findings.**

## Performance

- **Duration:** about 15 min (first commit 00:34:57 +08:00, last 00:40:00; the start time was not captured)
- **Tasks:** 2, both TDD with a RED `test(01-10)` commit before the GREEN `feat(01-10)` commit
- **Files:** 16 in the diff against the base commit (before this SUMMARY)

## Accomplishments

- `naming/mod.rs` registers W01 to W05 and holds the shared pieces: `type_finding` (apiName value), `property_finding` (key under `properties`), `off_hint`, `last_word`, and the test-only `testing::{objects, run, flagged}` helpers. `lint/mod.rs`, `structure/`, `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` were not touched.
- W01: all words generic, or a plural last word by suffix heuristic with an 18-word singular whitelist; the help proposes the singular spelling.
- W02: bare `value/type/status/date/name/quantity/score` is reported only when another property of the same object type ends in the same word; the message names the twins.
- W03: four fixed regexes held in a `LazyLock<[Regex; 4]>`; the message states which pattern matched (T-01-33).
- W04: classifies `date` and `timestamp` properties across all object types as suffix style or prefix style and reports the minority.
- W05: `split_camel` words are searched for seven bookkeeping runs; the `sequenceNumber` trade-off is in the module doc.

## Task Commits

1. **Task 1 (TDD):** RED `80ca867` (6 of 6 tests failed: the stub rules found nothing), GREEN `b65151b`
2. **Task 2 (TDD):** RED `6020a70` (5 of 5 new tests failed), GREEN `3d35d7e`

## TDD Gate Compliance

RED before GREEN for both tasks. Each RED commit contains compiling stub rules registered in `rules()`, so the failures are assertion failures and missing snapshots rather than compile errors. No REFACTOR commits were needed.

## Reuse decision

Question from the project rule: can `convert_case` replace `split_camel` (REUSE-AUDIT CONSIDER-LATER)? No, `split_camel` stays.

- crates.io (queried 2026-10-16): `convert_case` 0.12.0, 140,187,443 recent downloads, updated 2026-08-27, one runtime dependency `unicode-segmentation`.
- Neither `convert_case` nor `unicode-segmentation` is in `Cargo.lock`. Adopting it adds two new crates to audit and download, and needs `Cargo.toml` / `Cargo.lock` edits that this wave-6 plan is forbidden to make.
- Semantics would have to be re-created with a hand-picked boundary set (acronym, digit-letter both ways, lower-upper) and then proven equal to the `split_camel_cases` test; there is no gain over 25 lines that are already tested and have a real caller (W01, W02, W04, W05).
- `heck` (already a workspace dep) cannot do it either: per the audit it does not split at letter/digit boundaries.

Revisit only if a later rule needs configurable boundaries.

# Phase 1 Plan 11: Structure lint rules ONT-W06 to ONT-W11 Summary

**Six structure warnings (God Object, Silo, Rule of three, Action Sprawl, Time Machine, generic link names) run through `ontoforge lint` via `structure::rules()`, three of them with thresholds configurable in `ontoforge.toml`, each with a trigger and a clean insta snapshot; with 01-10 this completes W01 to W11 and the Phase 1 gate is green.**

## Performance

- **Duration:** about 8 min (first commit 00:43:59 +08:00, last 00:48:36; the start time was not captured)
- **Tasks:** 2, both TDD with a RED `test(01-11)` commit before the GREEN `feat(01-11)` commit
- **Files:** 19 in the diff against the base commit (before this SUMMARY)

## Accomplishments

- `structure/mod.rs` registers W06 to W11 and holds `off_hint`, `type_finding` and the test-only `testing::{object, join, run, run_with, flagged}`. `lint/mod.rs`, `lint/config.rs`, `lint/naming/`, `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` were not touched.
- W06: property count above `max_properties` (default 60), or a string discriminator whose last `split_camel` word is `type` / `subtype` above half the limit. The null-rate branch is Deferred and said so in the module doc (D-13).
- W07: first name word in `silo_prefixes` (default hr, sales, billing, crm) with at least two words; and pairs with the same primary key name and type, at least 4 properties each, Jaccard of `(name, base type)` sets at least 0.6, reported on the later type with the similarity to two decimals. Types are grouped by primary key before the pairwise comparison.
- W08: keys held by fewer than three types are dropped first, then triples of the remaining candidates are intersected; each distinct shared set is reported once on the first type by `apiName`, listing all types and properties.
- W09: per object type, the set of actions that create it or modify / delete through an `objectReference` parameter, against `max_actions_per_type` (default 10); plus `^(set|update)[A-Z]` actions whose only rule is a `modifyObject` assigning one property.
- W10: `version` / `revision` / `isCurrent` property keys and object type names matching `(\d{4}|[vV]\d+)$`. W11: link and end `apiName` matching `(?i)^(related|link\d)`; the "missing direction" part of the original rule is left to `ONT-V05` and the module doc says so.

## Task Commits

1. **Task 1 (TDD):** RED `0fbb79e` (9 of 10 tests failed on assertions against stub rules; the 10th is the V15 config test), GREEN `db6ee1c`
2. **Task 2 (TDD):** RED `781a788` (9 of 9 new tests failed on assertions and missing snapshots), GREEN `69bb151`

## TDD Gate Compliance

RED before GREEN for both tasks. Each RED commit contains compiling stub rules registered in `rules()`, so failures are assertion failures and missing snapshots, not compile errors (RED run with `INSTA_UPDATE=no`, so no `.snap.new` file was written). Snapshots were created in GREEN with `INSTA_UPDATE=always` and read before committing. No REFACTOR commits were needed.

## Reuse decision

No new crate. `regex` (already a dependency of `ontoforge-schema`, linear-time) covers W09 to W11; `split_camel` from `lint/words.rs` covers W06 and W07; `LintCx::option_usize` / `option_str_list` cover the three options. `did_you_mean` and `heck` have no role in these rules. Jaccard is a two-line formula over `BTreeSet::intersection`, so no similarity crate was considered.

# Phase 1 Plan 12: CEL criteria reference and type checking Summary

**Submission-criteria CEL is now statically checked at validate time: free variables, parameters, object properties and user fields are resolved against the ontology, and a conservative bool/int/double/string/list inference flags non-bool conditions and incompatible comparisons, all as unsuppressible ONT-V13 errors located at the YAML `condition` value.**

## Performance

- **Duration:** about 25 min
- **Completed:** 2026-10-15
- **Tasks:** 3 (Tasks 1 and 2 TDD: 2 test commits, 2 feat commits; Task 3 fixtures)
- **Files:** 3 source files and 1 test file in the crates, 10 fixture files, 5 snapshots, 1 ADR

## Accomplishments

- `check_ontology` iterates action types in BTreeMap order and criteria by index. Per condition it runs `analyze(src, |p| (member_paths(p, src), type_issues(p, src, env)))`, so both walks stay on the 32 MiB analyzer thread (T-01-38). Analyzer errors (too long, too deep, syntax) become one V13 and skip further checks for that condition.
- Reference rules follow D-09 exactly; suggestions use `ontoforge_schema::diag::did_you_mean`, so `ontoforge-expr` gains no `strsim` dependency and no `Cargo.toml` changed.
- `infer.rs`: `Ty { Bool, Int, Double, String, List, Any }`, `TypeEnv::for_action` (parameter types, object-reference property types, `user.id` string, `user.groups` list of string), comparison compatibility (int and double mix, Any matches all, lists compare element types), comprehension typing taken from the cel macro expansion.
- `pipeline::check` appends the CEL diagnostics, re-sorts, and clears `ontology` on any error.
- Five fixtures, each triggering exactly one V13; snapshots show line 19 column 16 (the opening quote of the condition) and a message tail such as `(at 1:21 in expression)`.
- ADR-0006: the `Open (spike)` section is replaced by `## Spike 结论（2026-10-15）`; Decision and Rejected untouched.

## Interface notes

- `ParameterDef` exposes `param_type` (not `r#type` as the plan's interface sketch said) and `PropertyDef` exposes `base_type`; `check.rs` and `infer.rs` use the real field names.
- 01-07 files (`limits.rs`, `analyze.rs`, `walk.rs`) were not modified; no interface adjustment was needed.
- `cel` binary-operator calls report the operator token as their offset, so type issues point at the operator (`==`), not the left operand.
- Known limitation, by design (A7): idents like `int` or `string` used as type names (`type(x) == int`) are reported as unknown variables, because the root set is fixed to `params`, `user`, `objects`.

**As a** 编写 ontology 的开发者, **I want to** 用 YAML/JSON 编写 ontology 并通过 `ontoforge validate` / `ontoforge lint` 得到带源码定位的诊断, **so that** 定义错误在被存储、action、API 使用之前就被定位修正，且仓库在 Windows 本机 `cargo test` 全绿。

> 来源说明见 01-01-PLAN.md 的 Phase Goal 节。本 plan 只关闭 SCHEMA-07 的编辑器补全缺口（ROADMAP Phase 1 Success Criterion 5 的编辑器侧）。

<objective>
关闭 UAT gap G-1-2：yaml-language-server 只把 `# yaml-language-server: $schema=` modeline 应用到它所在的那个 YAML document（按 `---` 切分），aviation 示例只在文件第 1 行写了 modeline，所以第 2 个及之后的 document（包括 UAT 在文件末尾追加的 document）没有 schema，既无补全也无诊断。

按编排器锁定的四项决策修复（以下称「编排决策 1-4」）：
1. 新增项目级编辑器配置 `.zed/settings.json` 与 `.vscode/settings.json`，用 `yaml.schemas` 把 `./schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json` 关联到 `examples/ontologies/**/*.yaml`；manifest `ontology.yaml` 保留自己的 manifest modeline（modeline 优先于 settings，debug session 已实测）。
2. aviation 的 objects.yaml、links.yaml、actions.yaml 在每个 `---` 之后补定义 schema modeline（共 10 处）；validate、lint --deny-warnings、YAML/JSON IR 等价测试保持通过。
3. CONTRIBUTING.md 增加「编辑器接入」一节。
4. Rust 回归测试：编辑器配置可按 JSON 解析、引用的 schema 路径存在、glob 覆盖 aviation 示例文件；aviation 定义文件每个 YAML document 都以 modeline 开头。

Purpose: 示例 ontology 在编辑器里的每个 document 都按导出的 JSON Schema 补全和校验，SCHEMA-07「用于编辑器补全」的承诺在多文档文件上成立，并且由测试守住不再回退。
Output: 两份编辑器配置、aviation 三个定义文件的 10 行 modeline、`schema_export.rs` 中两个回归测试、CONTRIBUTING.md 新节。
</objective>

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

交付三样东西：
- 按 ADR-0011 搭好的 cargo workspace；
- ontology-as-code 的定义格式（YAML / JSON），以及加载为单一 IR 的 loader；
- CLI 命令 `ontoforge validate`、`ontoforge lint` 和 JSON Schema 导出。

只做静态定义与静态检查。存储、action 执行、查询、服务进程都不在本 phase。本 phase 用到的 crate 是 `ontoforge-schema`、`ontoforge-expr`（只做 CEL 编译与引用检查）和 `ontoforge`（CLI）；其余 crate 只建骨架，能编译、有占位测试即可。

</domain>

<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

本 phase 的灰色地带都是技术实现问题。按用户的「决策自主」偏好（自行调研决定，必须由用户拍板的才问），全部由 Claude 决定，依据写在每条后面。

### 定义文件布局
- **D-01:** 一个 ontology 对应一个目录，根目录放 manifest `ontology.yaml`。manifest 包含 `apiName`、`displayName`、`description`，以及 `include` glob 列表（默认 `**/*.yaml`、`**/*.yml`、`**/*.json`）。其余文件的位置和数量不做限制。理由：开发者可以按领域自行拆分文件，loader 只看 glob 结果，不依赖目录约定。
- **D-02:** 每个定义文档都是带 `kind` 判别字段的对象，`kind` 取值为 `ObjectType` / `LinkType` / `ActionType`（预留 `Interface`、`ValueType`、`SharedProperty`，loader 遇到时报「v1 不支持」）。一个 YAML 文件可以用 `---` 写多个文档；JSON 文件可以是单个对象，也可以是对象数组。理由：`kind` 判别让 serde internally-tagged enum 和 JSON Schema 的 `oneOf` 都能直接表达，LLM 生成时也不容易混淆。 — **Reversibility:** one-way — 这是对外的 ontology-as-code 契约，发布后改字段名或结构，所有用户的定义文件都要迁移。
- **D-03:** 属性内联在 object type 里（`properties:` 下以 apiName 为 key 的 map）；link type 单独成文档，两端都写在 link type 里。理由：与 Foundry 的模型一致（link type 是独立资源）；1:N 外键属性仍在 object type 里声明，link type 只引用它。

### 命名与校验规则（遵循 Foundry 文档 + ADR-0002）
- **D-04:**
  - object type 的 apiName 用 PascalCase：`^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,99}$`，在 ontology 内唯一。
  - property 的 apiName 用 camelCase：`^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,99}$`，在 object type 内唯一。
  - link 两端的 apiName 用 camelCase，在所关联的 object type 范围内唯一，并且不能与该类型的属性同名。
  - action type 的 apiName 用 camelCase，在 ontology 内唯一；MCP 工具名在 Phase 7 由它派生为 kebab-case。
  - 依据：`docs/foundry/ontology/object-link-types/create-object-type.md`、`create-link-type.md`。保留关键字表由 research 补齐。
- **D-05:** 未知字段一律报错（serde `deny_unknown_fields`，诊断里附「你是否想写 X」建议）。理由：拼写错误静默忽略是 ontology-as-code 最常见的坑；以后新增字段属于向后兼容的扩展。
- **D-06:** 结构性错误属于 validate 范畴（hard error，不能关闭），例如解析失败、未知 base type、重复 apiName、引用不存在的类型或属性、主键类型非法、外键类型与目标主键不匹配。lint 的 ONT-* 规则在 IR 构建成功之后运行，可以配置。理由：IR 构建失败时 lint 无法运行，两层必须分开。

### Action type 定义形状
- **D-07:** 参数为 `parameters:`，以 apiName 为 key 的 map，字段有 `type`、`required`、`default`、`description`。type 取值为 base type，或 `objectReference: <ObjectType>`。
- **D-08:** rules 是有序列表，每条为 `{ kind: createObject | modifyObject | deleteObject | addLink | removeLink, ... }`。值来源用结构化写法，不用字符串模板：`{ param: x }` / `{ static: v }` / `{ currentUser: {} }` / `{ currentTime: {} }`。理由：结构化写法可以静态校验类型；字符串模板要再引入一种语法。 — **Reversibility:** one-way — 同属 ontology-as-code 契约。
- **D-09:** submission criteria 为列表，每条 `{ condition: <CEL 字符串>, failureMessage: <文本> }`。CEL 上下文变量固定为 `params`、`user`（`id`、`groups`）、`objects`（按参数名访问 objectReference 参数指向的对象当前属性）。本 phase 只做 CEL 编译、变量引用存在性检查、参数类型推断（取决于 spike 结论），不求值。

### 诊断与输出
- **D-10:** 诊断模型统一为 `{ code, severity, message, file, line, column, span, help }`。人类可读输出用 `miette` 的 fancy 渲染；`--format json` 输出该模型的 JSON 数组。validate 和 lint 共用同一模型。退出码：有 error 时为 1，否则为 0；`--deny-warnings` 让 warning 也返回 1。
- **D-11:** span 精度至少到产生问题的那个 key 或 value 节点。如果 spike 证明 `serde-saphyr` 无法按 IR 路径取 span，就退化为先解析成带 span 的 YAML 节点树，再反序列化为 IR，同时维护「IR 路径 → span」表。具体方案由 research / spike 决定，但「到节点级」这个精度要求不变。JSON 输入同样要求 line:col。

### Lint 规则范围与配置
- **D-12:** v1 schema 范围内适用的 E 级规则为 ONT-E08（action rule 组合约束）和 ONT-E09（base type 用途约束：主键 / title key / array 元素）。其余 E 级规则（派生属性、vector、scenario、value type、interface、security policy）因对应 schema 元素不在 v1，本 phase 不实现，规则 ID 保留。
- **D-13:** W01–W11 都实现，但只做静态部分。ONT-W06（God Object）只检查属性数量阈值和 `*Type` / `*Subtype` 判别列，空值率依赖数据，留到有存储之后。ONT-W07 的 Jaccard 比较只基于属性名和类型集合。
- **D-14:** lint 配置写在 ontology 根目录的 `ontoforge.toml`，`[lint]` 段中按规则 ID 设置 `"off" | "info" | "warn" | "error"`。CLI 的 `--config` 可以覆盖配置文件路径。理由：Rust 生态习惯用 TOML 做工具配置，也和 ontology 定义本身（YAML）区分开。
- **D-15:** 每条 lint 规则一个模块，每条规则配一组 fixture 测试（触发和不触发两种），用 `insta` 做快照。

### 示例 ontology
- **D-16:** 示例 ontology `examples/ontologies/aviation/` 沿用 Foundry 文档中的航空领域，包含 Airport、Aircraft、Flight、Pilot：
  - 1:N：Flight 的 departureAirport 外键；
  - 1:1：Aircraft 与当前维护记录，或类似关系；
  - M:N：Flight 与 Pilot 的机组分配；

- **D-17:** 10 个 crate 按 ADR-0011 一次性建好。共享依赖版本放在根 `Cargo.toml` 的 `[workspace.dependencies]`，lint 配置放在 `[workspace.lints]`（`unsafe_code = "forbid"`，clippy pedantic 选择性开启）。新增 `.gitattributes` 设置 `* text=auto eol=lf`，避免 Windows 上 CRLF 造成快照 diff。
- **D-18:** 本 phase 加 CI（GitHub Actions）：Windows 和 Ubuntu 两个平台跑 `cargo fmt --check`、`cargo clippy -D warnings`、`cargo test --workspace`。理由：DX-03 的回归门槛需要自动化守住，否则后续 phase 容易破坏 Windows 构建。

### nightly Iceberg 作业

`.github/workflows/nightly.yml` 每天运行一次，也可手动触发 `workflow_dispatch`。Trino 483/484 使用 PostgreSQL JDBC catalog 与真实 MinIO S3 warehouse。`ci/minio/Dockerfile` 固定官方 MinIO source commit 和 Go builder digest，复用原依赖图生成 scratch 测试镜像；自建产物保留 DEVELOPMENT 标识，不宣称官方预编译或 bit-reproducibility。版本、SHA256、source/runner 身份及运行证据写入 `target/phase072-minio/<run-id>/provenance.json`。

```bash

bash ci/iceberg-services.sh contract --trino 483
bash ci/iceberg-services.sh contract --trino 484
```

`contract` 验证 source/copy 均为29行、精确 Rust 测试、PG 的 `s3://warehouse/` metadata 与非空对象，并只重启 MinIO/Trino后复验，不重新 CTAS。`nightly` 再执行原有 Action atomicity/race/idempotency/outbox、Trino Action、完整 Engine/CLI corpus；各目标必须发现且实际执行非零测试。容器、network、volumes 按本次 owner label 和身份清理，已有服务不受影响；PG/Trino只发布 loopback 随机端口。

临时凭据只进入私有 env/catalog，Trino使用环境凭据 provider；原始日志按本次真实凭据扫描通过后才可公开。CI为主fixture和helper分别保存私有state，并用两个独立 `always()` 步骤补偿清理，第一项失败也会尝试第二项。helper在创建容器前持久化owner和lock token；清理失败保留state供重试。state不存在时无操作，资源或锁身份无法核验时拒绝删除。只有 **schedule 触发且失败** 才运行拥有 `issues: write` 的 `report-failure`；手动触发不创建 issue/comment，测试job始终只有 `contents: read`。

## 编辑器接入

- 定义文档与 manifest 的 JSON Schema 位于 `schemas/`，由 `ontoforge schema export` 生成；IR 改动后需重新导出。
- yaml-language-server 的 modeline（`# yaml-language-server: $schema=...`）只作用于它所在的那个 YAML document，不会延续到 `---` 之后的 document，见 https://github.com/redhat-developer/vscode-yaml/issues/1066 。因此 `examples/ontologies/aviation` 的定义文件在每个 `---` 的下一行都写一次定义 modeline。新增 document 时同样写在 `---` 的下一行，测试 `aviation_definition_documents_start_with_modeline` 会检查。
- 多文档文件以项目级 `yaml.schemas` 为准。仓库提供 `.zed/settings.json`（Zed，位于 `lsp.yaml-language-server.settings.yaml.schemas`）与 `.vscode/settings.json`（VS Code + Red Hat YAML 扩展，`yaml.schemas`），把 `./schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json` 关联到 `examples/ontologies/**/*.yaml`，并用 `!examples/ontologies/**/ontology.yaml` 排除 manifest。
- manifest 通过自己第 1 行的 manifest modeline 关联 manifest schema（modeline 优先于 settings）。没有 modeline 的 manifest 不关联任何 schema，不会被误按定义 schema 校验。
- 两份配置必须保持一致，且只写严格 JSON（不写注释），由测试 `editor_configs_associate_definition_schema_with_examples` 检查。
- JetBrains IDE 不读取上述两个文件：在 Settings → Languages & Frameworks → Schemas and DTDs → JSON Schema Mappings 中手动添加映射，`schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json` 对应定义文件，`schemas/ontoforge-manifest.schema.json` 对应 `ontology.yaml`。
- 补全触发：yaml-language-server 不声明补全触发字符，输入 `kind: ` 后不会自动弹出补全，需要按 Ctrl+Space（或键入值的首字母）。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

tree=$(cargo tree --workspace --locked --features ontoforge-storage/embedded-pg -e normal,build,dev --prefix none)
while read -r package _; do
  case "$package" in
    openssl | native-tls)
      printf '::error::Forbidden TLS dependency: %s\n' "$package" >&2
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done <<< "$tree"

"""Exercise the CI TLS guard with hermetic Cargo output on Windows and Linux."""

import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import textwrap
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
TREE_ARGS = (
    "tree --workspace --locked --features ontoforge-storage/embedded-pg "
    "-e normal,build,dev --prefix none"
)


def bash_path():
    if os.name == "nt":
        git = shutil.which("git")
        candidates = [Path(git).parent.parent / "bin/bash.exe"] if git else []
        candidates.append(Path(os.environ.get("ProgramFiles", "C:/Program Files"))
                          / "Git/bin/bash.exe")
        for candidate in candidates:
            if candidate.is_file():
                return str(candidate)
        raise RuntimeError("Git Bash is required; Windows System32 bash is WSL")
    bash = shutil.which("bash")
    if not bash:
        raise RuntimeError("Bash is required")
    return bash


def workflow_command():
    workflow = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ci.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    step = re.search(
        r"^      - name: No OpenSSL or native-tls in the dependency graph\n"
        r"(?P<body>(?:^        .*\n|^\n)+)", workflow, re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if step is None:
        raise AssertionError("CI TLS guard step is missing")
    run = re.search(r"^        run: (.*)\n", step["body"], re.MULTILINE)
    if run is None:
        raise AssertionError("CI TLS guard command is missing")
    if run[1] == "|":
        return textwrap.dedent(step["body"][run.end():])
    return run[1]


# The inverse-query branch emulates the old workflow for the RED reproduction.
# No real Cargo executable is called, even when the workflow launches a helper.
FAKE_CARGO = r"""
cargo() {
  printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$TLS_TEST_CALLS"
  if [ "$TLS_TEST_FAILURE" = 1 ]; then
    echo 'cargo tree fixture failure' >&2
    return 101
  fi
  case "$*" in
    *'-i openssl') [ "$TLS_TEST_OPENSSL" = 1 ]; return ;;
    *'-i native-tls') [ "$TLS_TEST_NATIVE_TLS" = 1 ]; return ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\n' "$TLS_TEST_TREE"
}
export -f cargo
"""


class TlsDependencyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def check_guard(self, tree, allowed, *, openssl=False, native_tls=False, failure=False):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ontoforge-tls-") as directory:
            calls = Path(directory) / "calls"
            env = os.environ.copy()
            env.pop("BASH_ENV", None)
            env.pop("ENV", None)
            env.update(
                TLS_TEST_CALLS=calls.as_posix(), TLS_TEST_TREE=tree,
                TLS_TEST_FAILURE=str(int(failure)), TLS_TEST_OPENSSL=str(int(openssl)),
                TLS_TEST_NATIVE_TLS=str(int(native_tls)),
            )
            result = subprocess.run(
                [bash_path(), "--noprofile", "--norc", "-e", "-o", "pipefail", "-c",
                 FAKE_CARGO + workflow_command()],
                cwd=ROOT, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20,
            )
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode == 0, allowed, result.stdout + result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(calls.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), [TREE_ARGS])

    def test_neither_package_is_allowed(self):
        self.check_guard("ontoforge v0.1.0\nrustls v0.23.0", True)

    def test_openssl_only_is_rejected(self):
        self.check_guard("ontoforge v0.1.0\nopenssl v0.10.0\nrustls v0.23.0", False,
                         openssl=True)

    def test_native_tls_only_is_rejected(self):
        self.check_guard("ontoforge v0.1.0\nnative-tls v0.2.0 (*)", False, native_tls=True)

    def test_both_packages_are_rejected(self):
        self.check_guard("openssl v0.10.0\nnative-tls v0.2.0", False,
                         openssl=True, native_tls=True)

    def test_cargo_failure_is_rejected(self):
        self.check_guard("", False, failure=True)

    def test_similar_package_names_are_allowed(self):
        self.check_guard("openssl-probe v0.1.0\nopenssl-sys v0.9.0\n"
                         "native-tls-extra v0.1.0\nmy-openssl v0.1.0\n"
                         "ontoforge v0.1.0 (/workspace/openssl)", True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

apiName: aviation
displayName: Aviation
description: Minimal aviation ontology used by the walking skeleton and the docs.
defaultProfile: dev

# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json
# Object data changes only through actions. Rules run in order; each property value
# comes from one of four sources: { param: x }, { static: v }, { currentUser: {} } or
# { currentTime: {} }. Submission criteria are CEL over `params`, `user` and `objects`.
kind: ActionType
apiName: assignPilot
displayName: Assign pilot
description: Put a pilot on the crew of a flight.
parameters:
  flight: { type: { objectReference: Flight }, required: true, displayName: Flight }
  pilot: { type: { objectReference: Pilot }, required: true, displayName: Pilot }
rules:
  - kind: addLink
    link: flightCrew
    from: flight
    to: pilot
submissionCriteria:
  - condition: "'dispatcher' in user.groups"
    failureMessage: "Only dispatchers can assign pilots"
---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json
kind: ActionType
apiName: delayFlight
displayName: Delay flight
description: Mark a flight as delayed and record how long.
parameters:
  flight: { type: { objectReference: Flight }, required: true, displayName: Flight }
  delayMinutes: { type: integer, required: true, displayName: Delay in minutes }
  reason: { type: string, default: "unspecified", displayName: Reason }
rules:
  - kind: modifyObject
    object: flight
    properties:
      status: { static: DELAYED }
      delayMinutes: { param: delayMinutes }
submissionCriteria:
  - condition: "params.delayMinutes > 0 && objects.flight.status != 'CANCELLED'"
    failureMessage: "Delay must be positive and cancelled flights cannot be delayed"
---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json
kind: ActionType
apiName: recordMaintenance
displayName: Record maintenance
description: Log a maintenance event for an aircraft, stamped with the user and the time.
parameters:
  recordId: { type: string, required: true, displayName: Record id }
  aircraftTailNumber: { type: string, required: true, displayName: Aircraft tail number }
  summary: { type: string, displayName: Summary }
rules:
  - kind: createObject
    objectType: MaintenanceRecord
    properties:
      recordId: { param: recordId }
      aircraftTailNumber: { param: aircraftTailNumber }
      performedAt: { currentTime: {} }
      performedBy: { currentUser: {} }
      summary: { param: summary }
submissionCriteria:
  - condition: "size(params.recordId) > 0"
    failureMessage: "recordId must not be empty"

# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json
# Each end's apiName is the accessor on that end's own objectType:
# Airport.departingFlights returns Flights, Flight.departureAirport returns an Airport.
# The foreignKey sits on the `to` end and has the type of the `from` end's primary key.
kind: LinkType
apiName: flightDepartureAirport
displayName: Flight departure airport
description: The airport a flight departs from.
cardinality: oneToMany
from: { objectType: Airport, apiName: departingFlights, displayName: Departing flights }
to: { objectType: Flight, apiName: departureAirport, displayName: Departure airport, foreignKey: departureAirportCode }
---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json
kind: LinkType
apiName: flightArrivalAirport
displayName: Flight arrival airport
description: The airport a flight arrives at.
cardinality: oneToMany
from: { objectType: Airport, apiName: arrivingFlights, displayName: Arriving flights }
to: { objectType: Flight, apiName: arrivalAirport, displayName: Arrival airport, foreignKey: arrivalAirportCode }
---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json
kind: LinkType
apiName: aircraftFlights
displayName: Aircraft flights
description: The flights an aircraft operates.
cardinality: oneToMany
from: { objectType: Aircraft, apiName: flights, displayName: Flights }
to: { objectType: Flight, apiName: aircraft, displayName: Aircraft, foreignKey: aircraftTailNumber }
---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json
kind: LinkType
apiName: aircraftCurrentMaintenance
displayName: Aircraft current maintenance
description: The maintenance record that is currently open for an aircraft.
cardinality: oneToOne
from: { objectType: Aircraft, apiName: currentMaintenanceRecord, displayName: Current maintenance record }
to: { objectType: MaintenanceRecord, apiName: aircraft, displayName: Aircraft, foreignKey: aircraftTailNumber }
---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schemas/ontoforge-definition.schema.json
kind: LinkType
apiName: flightCrew
displayName: Flight crew
description: The pilots assigned to a flight. The system manages the join, so no foreignKey is written.
cardinality: manyToMany
from: { objectType: Flight, apiName: crew, displayName: Crew }
to: { objectType: Pilot, apiName: assignedFlights, displayName: Assigned flights }
backing: source
